issues.claim: https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/ (cited for: Kafka guarantees order only within a partition; the same key goes to the same partition; the default partitioner hashes the key)

issues.claim: https://www.rabbitmq.com/docs/confirms (cited for: the broker requeues unacknowledged deliveries when the channel closes; a publisher that gets no confirm republishes the message and this produces duplicates)
issues.problem: The fetched excerpt covers only basic.reject/basic.nack requeueing, the requeue loop and prefetch. It shows neither requeue on channel or connection close nor publisher confirms with republishing. The rebuttal says 'from memory' and asks the checker to confirm from the excerpt, but the excerpt does not show it.
issues.suggestedFix: Re-fetch the sections 'Automatic Requeueing' and 'Publisher Confirms' (or 'Publisher Confirms and Guarantees of Delivery') of the confirms page, so the excerpt shows that unacknowledged deliveries are requeued after a connection or channel loss. It should also show that an unconfirmed publish may be retried and that this can duplicate messages. If the page does not show it, reword the claims to what it says.

issues.claim: KafkaConsumer Javadoc (cited for: Kafka keeps the group position as the committed offset; after a rebalance the new owner continues from the last committed offset, so records processed after the last commit are processed again)
issues.problem: The URL resolves (title 'KafkaConsumer (kafka 3.9.2 API)'). The excerpt shows rebalancing, reassignment of partitions and commit failures for non-members. It does not show that the new owner resumes from the last committed offset or that already-processed records are re-read. The Javadoc section 'Offsets and Consumer Position' probably says so, but it was not fetched.
issues.suggestedFix: Re-fetch the 'Offsets and Consumer Position' section, or cite https://kafka.apache.org/documentation/#design_deliverysemantics, and confirm that the excerpt shows resuming from the committed position after a failure or reassignment.
